summary: A press aide who distributed an approved speech hears a different delivery in the hall.
realLife: Murphy remembered the St. Louis campaign finale as a speech already circulated to reporters, followed by Truman making notes and ultimately speaking without consulting them.
inGame: needs: released draft and actual remarks.

turns.pulledBy: The speaker stays close to the draft.
turns.what: A helper checks quotations against the delivery.

turns.pulledBy: The speaker gives substantially different remarks.
turns.what: The press staff identifies the delivered version.
turns.writesBack: The draft cannot stand as the record of the event.
